basis.structured_existing_ood: generation authority is already covered separately; this delta does not duplicate it

R0_observe: Current runtime contract distinguishes trusted Runtime process-runner admission from DB-profile inference configuration.
Current main additionally binds the declared local model artifact to the admitted runner rather than treating a readable decoy path as sufficient authority.

Existing cognition OOD includes generic missing-authority lesions and generation-authority cases, but no structural case where a database profile tries to choose a different executable than the runtime-admitted runner.
Repository/PR search found no overlapping open runner-capability cognition OOD lane before this write.
grf.R1_infer: Without a matched cognition evaluation, a checkpoint can appear authority-aware while still treating profile-supplied executable selection as process capability. Runtime will fail closed, but the cognition layer would not demonstrate the same authority abstraction.
R2_generate: Rely only on the runtime guard.
Add literal product-specific local_exec prompts that reveal the desired answer.
Add structural role/contract/provenance OOD cases with neutral runner labels and counterbalanced record order.
grf.R3_counter: A structural suite can still be shortcut by record order or privileged-looking executable names; therefore runner labels are neutral/distinct, presentation order is 32/32, and four prompt surfaces are used.
grf.R5_emergent: Capability authority should transfer across layers: cognition may propose configuration, but executable process authority must remain a separately admitted runtime fact.
